Notes The compiled inventory encompasses 93 distinct thermal generation assets (>30 MWe), representing an aggregate system footprint of 90,119 MWe. This total reconciles precisely across the dataset: 28,185 MWe currently operating, 205 MWe explicitly retired, 13,149 MWe under construction, and 48,580 MWe in planned or delayed stages. - **Formosa Hà Tĩnh & Industrial Cogeneration**: Categorized as complex industrial cogeneration. PDP7a schedules multiple phases utilizing both coal and blast furnace gas, culminating in 500 MWe of captive/grid thermal capacity. PDP8 further carves out unlimited capacity potential for industrial by-product facilities (e.g., Hải Hà 1, Hòa Phát II, Đức Giang, Formosa HT2) to maximize energy efficiency. - **Thủ Đức & Cần Thơ**: Both sites operate dual-fuel or mixed-cycle configurations. Thủ Đức combines 114 MWe of gas turbine capacity with 165 MWe of oil-fired capacity (279 MWe total). Cần Thơ similarly blends 150 MWe of gas and 35 MWe of oil (185 MWe total). - **Ô Môn Complex**: Currently anchored by the 660 MWe Ô Môn 1 plant. PDP8 envisions a massive expansion (Ô Môn 2, 3, and 4) adding 3,150 MWe, strictly contingent upon the upstream development of the Lô B (Block B) gas field. - **Quảng Trạch 2 Fuel Conversion**: Originally planned as a 1,200 MWe coal facility under revised PDP7, PDP8 Annex II Table 1 explicitly converts this asset to a 1,500 MWe LNG facility following government approval in early 2022. - **Sơn Mỹ 1 & 2**: Planned as major LNG-to-power hubs (2,250 MWe each). Sơn Mỹ 1 is structured as a BOT project, while Sơn Mỹ 2 is assigned to PVN; both face long-lead LNG supply chain dependencies. - **Retired Assets**: Uông Bí 1 (105 MWe) and Ninh Bình (100 MWe) are explicitly flagged in PDP7 Annex II for decommissioning post-2020 due to age and environmental inefficiencies, removing 205 MWe from the active baseline. ### Annotated Bibliography - **evn_ar_2010_2011_capacities**: Vietnam Electricity (EVN) Annual Report 2010-2011. Primary operator baseline detailing installed capacities and ownership structures prior to the GENCO reorganizations. - **evn_ar_2017_capacities**: Vietnam Electricity Annual Report 2017. Primary source for the post-restructuring GENCO 1, 2, and 3 thermal asset rosters and operational capacities. - **evn_ar_2018_capacities**: Vietnam Electricity Annual Report 2018. Primary operator update capturing the commissioning of major thermal assets like Thái Bình 1 and Vĩnh Tân 4. - **pdp7_annex1** & **pdp7_annex2**: Prime Ministerial Decision 1208/QĐ-TTg (2011). Foundational policy annexes outlining the original PDP7 commissioning schedules and the 2021-2030 forward-looking thermal pipeline. - **pdp7a_annex1_table1**, **table2**, **table3**: Prime Ministerial Decision 428/QĐ-TTg (2016). Revised PDP7 annexes providing the corrected 2016-2030 commissioning roster, critical for tracking historical delays and BOT project lineage. - **pdp8_annex2_table1**, **table2**, **table3**, **table4**, **table5**: Prime Ministerial Decision 500/QĐ-TTg (2023). The definitive current-policy primary source for PDP8, categorizing LNG, domestic gas, under-construction coal, cogeneration, and delayed/troubled coal projects with explicit implementation notes. - **report_32_annex1** & **report_58_annex**: Government Steering Committee progress reports on revised PDP7 priority projects. Vital secondary implementation sources providing ground-truth schedule evaluations, delay reasoning, and BOT/IPP status tracking. - **study_e542_pl9_1**, **pl9_2**, **pl9_5a**: PDP8 Draft 3 Study E-542 Annexes. Technical planning documents mapping the pre-policy option space, regional import-coal site potentials, and long-horizon LNG/thermal candidate projects.
